verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਰੂਪ ਰੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਅੰਗ ਛਬਿ ਦੇਹ ਕੈ ਬਿਦੇਹ ਅਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gursikh saadh roop ra(n)g a(n)g a(n)g chhab dheh kai bidheh aau sa(n)saaree nira(n)kaaree hai ||

en.bdb: An obedient Sikh of the True Guru becomes divinely of form and complexion. Every limb of his body radiates the glow of the Guru. He becomes free of all external adorations. He acquires celestial traits and gives up worldly characteristics.

verses.gurmukhi: ਦਰਸ ਦਰਸਿ ਸਮਦਰਸਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਧਿਆਨ ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: dharas dharas samadharas braham dhiaan sabadh surat gur braham beechaaree hai ||

en.bdb: By beholding a glimpse of the True Guru, he becomes uniform of behaviour and all knowing. By the union of Guru's words with his mind, he becomes contemplator of the Lord.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਲੇਖ ਕੈ ਅਲੇਖ ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨਿ ਕੈ ਬਿਕਾਰੀ ਉਪਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥
verses.translit_en: gur upadhes paraves lekh kai alekh charan saran kai bikaaree upakaaree hai ||

en.bdb: With the acquisition of True Guru's teachings and lodging it in the heart, he is freed from rendering all accounts of his life. By the refuge of the True Guru, he becomes benevolent from vice-ridden.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪ੍ਰਦਛਨਾ ਕੈ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਾਦਿਕ ਪਰਿਕ੍ਰਿਮਾਦਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਅਗ੍ਰਭਾਗ ਆਗਿਆਕਾਰੀ ਹੈ ॥੨੬੦॥
verses.translit_en: pradhachhanaa kai brahamaadhik parikiramaadh pooran braham agrabhaag aagiaakaaree hai ||260||

en.bdb: The Guru's disciple who becomes obedient of complete Godlike True Guru, and is always at His service; he is respected and sacrificed unto by all the gods just because he has sacrificed himself over his True Guru. (260)
